headline: As of 2026-10-05: 1,236,409 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 30 of 50 states, D+33.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,236,409 early/mail ballots cast so far across 30 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+33.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (349,576), New Jersey (178,984), Florida (148,603).
